response.sql: WITH artifact_total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, articount, articount * 1.0 / total AS share FROM scanfeatures CROSS JOIN artifact_total WHERE articount IS NOT NULL AND total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref, articount, share, share - avg_share AS difference_from_average FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_average IS NULL, difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10;
